abort.unsupported_manual_setup: Configuration is only supported via auto-discovery. Check HeishaMon is connected to your MQTT server and sending messages. Also check that Home Assistant is connected to the MQTT server. The integration will then be discovered automatically.

init.title: Entities and installation
init.description: The heat pump reports which optional parts are installed (DHW tank, buffer tank, solar, bivalent, SG ready, optional PCB, cooling). Entities belonging to such a part are disabled by default.

data.settings_guard: Refuse settings that have no effect while the setting they depend on is off

options.enable_only: Enable them once the part is reported as installed
options.unavailable: Also show them as unavailable while the part is not installed
options.disable: Also disable them while the part is not installed

heat_pump_fault.title: Heat pump fault {code}
heat_pump_fault.description:
The heat pump reports fault **{code}**: {description}.

The heat pump may stay stopped until the fault is reset. Remove the cause first, then press the button "Reset fault code" of the heat pump. This message disappears when the heat pump reports no fault anymore.

command_failed.title: Heat pump did not take over a command
command_failed.description:
`{entity}` was set to **{expected}**, but after {attempts} attempts the heat pump still reports **{received}**.

Check that HeishaMon is online and not in listen-only mode, and that the heat pump accepts this value in its current settings. This message disappears when the next command of this entity is taken over.

setting_needs_parent.message: {command} has no effect now: {parent} is {actual}, it would have to be {needed}. Change that setting first, or switch off the check in the options of the integration.
